people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
translations.bsb: To this He replied, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this way?
translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
translations.asv: And he answered and said unto them, Think ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they have suffered these things?
